title: Senior Engineer - Network and Security
description:
**Role: Senior Engineer – Network and Security**
  

**Location: Chennai**

  

**Role Description**


The **Senior Engineer – Network and Security** is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining complex network infrastructures to ensure optimal performance, scalability, and security. This role requires expertise in advanced network data protocols, enterprise network architecture, and security systems. The Senior Network Engineer will also play a key role in troubleshooting critical network issues, mentoring junior engineers, and collaborating with cross\-functional IT teams to develop and enforce network policies. Staying updated with the latest networking technologies and best practices is essential to continuously improving the network environment. Additionally, the Lead Network Engineer will work closely with the **Network and Security Manager** to coordinate the **Network team**, ensuring effective resource allocation, project execution, and network security enforcement.

  

**Responsibilities**


* Assist in the design and deployment of functional and scalable network solutions.
* Configure, install, and maintain various network devices and services (e.g., routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPNs).
* Monitor network performance, ensuring system availability and reliability.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve advanced network issues efficiently.
* Perform network maintenance and system upgrades, including patches, service packs, hot fixes, and security configurations.
* Implement and manage network security measures to protect data, software, and hardware.
* Participate in IT infrastructure projects within the service area.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all network implementations.
* Lead and mentor junior network engineers, providing technical guidance and training.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and organizational network policies.
* Collaborate with IT teams to design and enhance network architectures.
* Evaluate emerging technologies to optimize network performance and security.
* **Coordinate with the Network and Security Manager to manage and oversee the Chennai Network team, ensuring seamless collaboration and efficient project execution.**
  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**


* Relevant industry certifications
* Expertise in advanced network data protocols and enterprise\-level networking solutions.
* Strong proficiency in network monitoring, diagnostic tools, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in implementing and managing enterprise network security systems.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure while managing multiple tasks.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with IT professionals and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated leadership ability, with experience mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
* In\-depth understanding of the OSI model, networking principles, and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience in configuring and maintaining network hardware for platforms used in the service area.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills to meet project deadlines.
* Proven experience in large\-scale network deployments and high\-availability network designs.
* **Experience in managing or assisting with team leadership in network engineering projects.**
* **Years of experience 8\+**

  

This role is ideal for a **Senior Engineer – Network \& Security** who is looking to take on a leadership position, contribute to **high\-impact IT infrastructure projects**, and play a key role in managing the **Network team** alongside the **Network and Security Manager**.

  



**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Network & Security IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:

title: Engr I-Ntwk Operations
description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

**What you’ll be doing…**


The Network Repair Bureau (NRB) seeks driven and highly motivated Engineers to join our team. This position is responsible for centralized troubleshooting of customer issues and the Verizon Wireless Network's operation and management. As a part of a highly visible team where we provide 24x7 support, you are accountable for ensuring high network availability and attainment of service levels. You will learn and apply new technical skills to support the interdepartmental objectives including: effectively communicating and escalating network issues to ensure quick resolution; utilizing a network management system to detect network events; and creating trouble tickets to document issues. You’ll also have opportunities for career growth as you learn and apply new skills with various technologies to support the organization's objectives.


**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Performing triage, fault isolation, and remediation of Network events.
* Developing your professional skills and technical knowledge through on\-the\-job experience and training.
* Partnering with senior engineers to provide timely and accurate technical assistance to our internal and external customers.
* Applying acquired technical knowledge to monitor and troubleshoot issues, ensuring the health of the network while working closely with external and internal organizations
* Providing on\-demand support to eliminate unexpected service impacts to our customers based on the needs of the business. (Our customers may include customer service centers, technical support organizations, and executive management teams during network events and major outages.)

**What we’re looking for…**


You’re a motivated self\-starter and quick learner who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. You meet all new challenges with a commitment to quality and team collaboration. You are flexible, dependable, and work well in varying environments.


You’ll need to have:

* Bachelor’s degree or One or more years of related work experience.
* Ability to work 24/7 operational schedule, including night shifts, weekends, and designated holidays, in alignment with operational requirements.
* Experience working in a customer service setting.
* Expertise in managing customer communications and telephone interactions.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or any other related discipline
* Knowledge of LTE networks and 4G to 5G technologies.
* Experience in troubleshooting and/or telecommunications.
* Knowledge of Cloud and Virtualized solutions (OpenStack/ VMWare).
* Network certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, or similar).
* Scripting with Python, No\-JS, Perl, or equivalent languages.
* Experience in computer support experience, including troubleshooting PC hardware and configurations.
* Ability to work in a high\-pressure, dynamic environment and adjust to priority changes
* Ability to work well in a team environment.

### **Where you’ll be working**


In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

title: Lead EMS Engineer - Systems Engineering
description:
Systems engineering is a cross\-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs.
  

Lead system engineer is responsible for Design engineering and coordination/key technical interface to customer and vendors in execution of EMS/Sub\-station automation/Marine/O\&G/Power Projects in time, quality and budget. System engineer will also closely work with service organization to ensure that new developments are aligned with business strategy and are compliant with latest regulation and standards.
**Job Description**
===================


* Basic and Detailed engineering for EMS/SAS/MIROGRID based projects and solutions.
* Knowledge and experience on complex network topologies, switch configuration, Routers, etc.
* Knowledge on configuration of Network protocols such as RSTP, PRP, MRP and SNMP
* Knowledge on Integration, configuration, simulation, and analysis of substation communication protocols such as IEC 61850(MMS/GOOSE), IEC 60870\-5\-101,104, DNP3\.0, Profinet, OPCUA, OPCDA and Modbus.
* Knowledge on Time synchronization (NTP, PTP)
* Knowledge and experience on simulation tools like DTM, IED scout, Test suite pro, Modsim.
* Knowledge and experience in network analyzing/Network storm testing tools
* PLC Programming with Function blocks, Structure Text and Sequential flow chart for Power Management Applications
* Proficient in preparing SLD, Schematics, Network Architecture, BOM and reports. Knowledge in PLM is preferable.
* Knowledge on programming (Python , Embedded C , Any C\# ) is preferred.
* Knowledge and experience on Electrical Power Management System (EPMS), Generator Management system (GMS), Load Sharing and Load shedding priorities is preferred.
* Knowledge on cybersecurity is preferred.
* Support the Business Verticals in creating and reviewing (in conjunction with the leadership team) systems solutions as part of the OTR process, ensuring that solutions are technically fit for purpose and that technical risk is understood and managed with contingencies identified.
* Perform project execution \- Analyze customer's contract, prepare specifications to vendors and internal stake holders
* Prepare technical documentation as per contractual requirements, vendor documentation review
* Identify technical risks and put in place the mitigation plan
* Review solutions developed and identify opportunities for improvement of process, system, or equipment
* Ensure strict compliance with all company and customer’s EHS policies and procedures
* Identify and propose improvements in processes, tools, system solutions and technologies, rolling out improvements when agreed with leadership team.
* Foster relationship with other GE Vernova business entities to maximize the benefits of synergies.
* Liaise with Platform Engineering, Technology and Value Engineering, and Supply Chain as appropriate to support the project and the business.
* Liaise with other GE Vernova businesses, platform verticals, supply chain, sub\-contractors and suppliers as appropriate to support the project and the business
* Drive lean mind set to provide optimum technical solutions for the projects.
* Comply with all company and customer health and safety regulations.

Qualifications/Requirements :


* Degree level in Electrical engineering from reputed College/University.
* 10\+ years of experience in Communication protocols, Networks, Protection relays, Controls in EMS / SAS
* Experience in capturing requirements and writing technical specifications
* Understanding of communication protocols (TCP socket and Serial communications, Knowledge of DNP3, IEC 61850 and IEC 60870\-5\-101 (IEC 101\) protocols would be beneficial
* Knowledge of design principles and have the capability to write clear documentation
* Flexible, adaptable and enthusiastic approach, good great team mate and an effective communicator
* Previous experience in a similar or related role.

Desired Characteristics :


* Strong oral and written communication skills, interpersonal skills
* Able to interface effectively with all levels of organization and external customers.
* Displays good interpersonal skills – is accessible and approachable.
* Anticipates customer needs and ensures they are met
* Willingness to learn with passion
* Self\-motivated, creative and a team player, with ability to come up with unique solutions to complex problems
* Capable of working with multi\-disciplined international team with good personal organization skills.
* Ability to multi\-task on a variety of projects to strict time scales
* Quickly identify best practices and apply them within the team
* Strong prioritizing and time management skills
* Willing to travel on short notice within base country and overseas for short/long term assignments
* Willing to work extended hours during the week, at weekends/holidays at critical times.

**About Us**


GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

  

Disclosure of your Gender or Sexual orientation is completely Voluntary and not mandatory.

title: Network Engineer 3
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


About Comcast Next Generation Access Networks (NGAN) NGAN (Next Gen Access Networks) is a group within Headquarters at Comcast that partners with all three divisional Engineering \& Technical Operations teams to drive expansion, new technologies and continuous improvement into the ‘last mile’ of the network.**Job Description**


Job Description Are you passionate about digital media, entertainment, and access technologies? Do you like big challenges and working within a highly motivated team environment? The Next Gen Access Technologies team is a small and fast\-moving team of world\-class experts who are innovating in end\-to\-end IP services delivery. As a test engineer on the next gen access team, you will be verifying the quality of current and future technologies that will enable next generation services to our customers. We are a team that thrives on big challenges, results, quality, and agility.  

Who does the Next Gen Access Technologies team work with?  

The team manages new technology development and deployment programs that require coordination across multiple teams. There is a strong, collaborative relationship between Next Gen Access, developers, vendors, QA engineers, deployment and operations teams as partners in the delivery of quality systems and services. We work at all levels of the organization to plan and deliver new services and service capabilities.  

What are some interesting problems you’ll be working on?  

In this role, you will be part of a team that is responsible for the development, verification, and benchmarking Comcast’s next generation access products and network capabilities. This effort will  

require working directly with the RF and network equipment in Comcast’s test labs. In addition, you will work with system engineers on reproducing and debugging issues found in the field.  

Where can you make an impact?  

You’ll be working with the best and brightest minds in Comcast to verify the access networks infrastructure and products that will power the next generation of services. Success in this role is characterized by a higher speed to market as well as fewer customer\-facing defects and outages of equipment and services that delight and entertain our customers.  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Coordinate with fellow team members and the test lead during test runs.
* Perform the execution of automated test suites and investigate issues and failures found.
* Perform quality assurance testing on iterations of code and hardware with and without automation.
* Assist the system engineers in reproducing and troubleshooting field issues.

**Skills \& Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience.
* 6\-8 years of network testing experience.
* Strong preference for a minimum 5 years in a combination of cable network architecture, specification, engineering, validation.
* Knowledge of various RF and network testing equipment such as spectrum analyzers, packet generators, routers, etc.
* Experience in testing to standards.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Keen attention to detail a must.
* High level of engagement and commitment.
**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

title: QA/QC TEAM LEAD
description:
**Company Description**  

Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.  

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.  

  

In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.  

  

The Eurofins network generated EUR 7\.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.


**ENTITY NAME\-EUROFINS ASSURANCE INDIA PVT. LTD.**

 **Job Description**  

* Oversee the entire QA QC operation and ensure the program is run smoothly.
* Supporting the QA QC Program Director to build up the local team with required sizing to cope with the business growth.
* Assist the program onboarding process for new suppliers.
* Accountable to ensure all team members are discipline to follow the program procedures or SOPs without failure.
* Implement the internal training (e.g.QA QC procedure and SOPs) and certification process to ensure all appointed QA QC engineers are qualified to master the QA QC jobs well.
* Supporting Eurofins CPA Quality to carry out the Continuous Improvement Program (CIP) to maintain the team’s performance with customer’s expectation.
* Ensure all the inspection reports, including Pre\-Production Meeting, Troubleshooting are issued on time and accurate with correct division owner delivery.
* Review, approve and issue the weekly production reports to customer in a timely basis, they are 1\) Work in process report (WIP), 2\) 5 or 7 Steps Tracker, 3\) CAP Log (Corrective Action Plan), 4\) QA QC Schedule, and 5\) Weekly client Program Operation Summary.
* Review all the client program inspection reports and provide quality comments in the report distribution email, especially the failed inspection reports.
* Ensure all the reports issued \& presented in a professional manner in term of data accuracy \& completeness and neat presentation.
* Assist to carry out the troubleshooting when necessary.
* Identify and mitigate the risks throughout supply chain to ensure defined quality and turnaround time are maintained.
* Provide technical expertise to internal and external customers.
* Support to establish QA QC planning to conduct the Pre\-Production meeting, inline inspections, daily visit inspections, final random inspections, and container loading inspections.
* Attend meeting with Client Production team virtually when required.
* Listening to and addressing teammate concerns, forwarding to the client QA QC Program Director as appropriate.
* Addressing any conflicts within the team that may arise.
* Increasing team motivation and sharing positive feedback and praise.
* Circulating company information and updates within the team.
* 15\+ years’ of experience in Quality and Production in reputed factory/ buying house.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Degree holder in Textile and Quality Assurance discipline or equivalent working experience (Textile Engineer is preferable).

  

**Additional Information**  

* Factory handling capacity/ Production Planning Control (PPC) experience.
* Experience in leading team and good management skill.
* Customer oriented, mature, independent, and able to work under pressure.
* Self\-organized, rigorous, demanding.
* Team player.
* Computer skills (Microsoft Office).
* Excellent interpersonal and written and oral communication skills.
* Fluent in English (Oral \& Written).
